caption:
Momo stands on the shop floor for eight hours a day. By closing time her feet, calves and lower back feel heavy.

Standing in one position for hours keeps the same muscles working, so they can tire quickly. Clinical Pilates builds stamina in the hips, trunk and feet, which can help with long shifts on your feet.

Hybi's routine: rest one foot on a low step and swap, do 10 calf raises three times a shift, and march on the spot for 20 steps every 30 minutes.

Painful first steps in the morning, leg swelling or tingling, or no change after two weeks are worth an assessment first. Clinical Pilates at Hybrid Physio can help. Book online via the link in bio 🛍️
